privileged_info_for_vlm: Verified values for the report: 1. Hydrogen Cyanide: PEL 10 ppm, IDLH 50 ppm. 2. Ammonia: PEL 50 ppm, IDLH 300 ppm. 3. Carbon Monoxide: PEL 50 ppm, IDLH 1200 ppm. 4. Chlorine: PEL 1 ppm (ceiling), IDLH 10 ppm. 5. Methyl Ethyl Ketone (MEK): PEL 200 ppm, IDLH 3000 ppm. The chemical with the lowest IDLH is Chlorine (10 ppm). The report must be at ~/Documents/exposure_limits_report.txt and end with 'LOWEST_IDLH: Chlorine'.
